title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quant - Averages
subject: Quant

questions.q: There are four numbers such that the average of the first two numbers is 1 more than the first number, the average of the first three numbers is 2 more than the average of the first two numbers, and the average of the first four numbers is 3 more than the average of the first three numbers. Then, the difference between the largest and the smallest numbers, is
questions.explain: Let numbers be $A, B, C, D$. $(A+B)/2 = A+1 \implies B = A+2$. Let $Avg_2 = A+1$. $Avg_3 = Avg_2 + 2 = A+3$. So $(A+B+C) = 3(A+3) = 3A+9$. Since $A+B = 2A+2$, $C = (3A+9) - (2A+2) = A+7$. Let $Avg_3 = A+3$. $Avg_4 = Avg_3 + 3 = A+6$. $(A+B+C+D) = 4(A+6) = 4A+24$. $D = (4A+24) - (3A+9) = A+15$. The numbers are $A, A+2, A+7, A+15$. Largest is $A+15$ and smallest is $A$. Difference = $15$.
